headline: Cyclops assembles massive X-Men rosters to fight vampire mutants
post:

headline: James Marsden returns as Cyclops in Avengers: Doomsday
post:
Big changes are coming for Scott Summers! According to Screen Rant, James Marsden is officially reprising his role as the iconic mutant leader in Avengers: Doomsday. Fans of the original Fox films might remember that Wolverine often took the spotlight, leaving the hero with less screen time. But Marsden recently shared in an interview with Sharp Magazine that he only agreed to come back if his character had a "genuine purpose" rather than just a quick nostalgic appearance. The star stressed that he wanted his return to feel meaningful this time around. Directors Joe and Anthony Russo are bringing back several original Fox actors for this massive MCU epic, including Ian McKellen as Magneto and Rebecca Romijn as Mystique, as they face off against Robert Downey Jr.'s Doctor Doom. Are you excited to finally see Scott take charge alongside Earth's mightiest heroes?

#AvengersDoomsday #XMen #Cyclops
original_title: Avengers: Doomsday Rectifies X-Men Icon’s Role After Fox Era Fumbled The Original Trilogy
